main_body: two-story timber and stone building with hipped tile roof
top_band: tiled roof surface in brown/tan tones from row 1 to 43
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened hipped roof (rows 1-43) with chimney top visible, overhanging a two-story front facade (rows 44-106) with a clear eave shadow (rows 44-47) and recessed windows and door.

style.evidence: The candidate is a 4-color reduction/posterization of the Beodeul reference style. Plaster panels on the upper floor are huge completely flat fills with zero speckle or shading; roof tiles and stones lose their multi-step highlights and depth; windows and sign are filled with a flat dark tone.
